title: justicia leonardii
intro: Justicia leonardii, commonly known as Sambuc elder or Justicia, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, including the alleviation of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Justicia leonardii are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Justicia leonardii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
